design.rationale: B/C chosen from Doc-77/78 exploratory results: post-hoc selection, no generalization claim
design.seeds: same tsp_seed as the frozen r1 spec of the same condition (identical for both runs of a condition)
design.physical_protocol: inherited unchanged: fresh Stage+Karto, map3, same route/actions/347-frame budget

qualification.first_pair: D79_B_Lplus_1 then D79_B_Lminus_1 must pass technical checks before runs 3-8
technical_checks: native scan processing barrier satisfied at all four boundaries
sync export success, path echo, run_id, counts, sha256
provenance non-empty, run_id match, sequences monotone
ledger covers four boundaries, accepted/received counters consistent
qualification.failure_policy: record truthfully; retry allowed only as a new attempt within the 8-run budget; big code fix => stop suite

analysis.comparison: topic cache vs sync dump (nodes/edges only present in sync, timing lag)
analysis.mechanism: provenance enum classification + endpoints + creation time; rejection causes NOT observable
analysis.gt: SE(2) relative pose error with explicit extrinsics; pre-action alignment only; GT_EFFECT_NOT_ESTIMABLE when insufficient
analysis.pre_action_features: two candidates only: historical view/direction overlap; residual rotation/translation to keyframe gate
analysis.diagnostics: any fixed-linearization/edge-removal result labelled FIXED_LINEARIZATION_FACTOR_DIAGNOSTIC and reported separately

decision_rules.technical: MEASUREMENT_VALIDATED vs MEASUREMENT_NOT_VALIDATED (no science ordering if not validated)
forbidden_inferences: sync nodes => all new historic constraints valid
